name: 使用 SAP Ariba Sourcing 的集中采购 (4QN)
name_en: Central Procurement with SAP Ariba Sourcing (4QN)
description_en_html:
Overview

The SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition Hub system offers a centralized RFQ process with a deep integration into the customer's landscape. It connects SAP Ariba Sourcing to the customer’s SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system (on-premise or Cloud).

With the SAP S/4HANA Hub system, you can pool or aggregate purchase requisitions created in multiple connected backend systems to create a single central RFQ and thus get support for better scale pricing.

SAP Ariba Sourcing provides access to intuitive RFX tools (for requests for information, requests for proposals, and reverse auctions), connections to more than two million companies, quick and easy supplier discovery, and automated and adjustable negotiation procedures.

Once the award process is completed in SAP Ariba Sourcing, the supplier contract that is created in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition Hub system generates either purchase orders or contracts in the respective connected backend system.

Key Process Flow

  • Create a central RFQ in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition Hub system for purchase requisitions that are created in the connected backend systems (central purchaser)
  • Send the central RFQ to the SAP Ariba Sourcing application, which triggers a sourcing request in SAP Ariba
  • Access your worklist and convert sourcing requests into sourcing projects/ events (sourcing manager)
  • Monitor sourcing projects that result in RFI/RFP/Auctions and discover suppliers via Ariba Network and monitor suppliers’ responses (sourcing manager)
  • Award one or more bids in SAP Ariba Sourcing (sourcing manager)
  • Send awarded bids automatically to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition central hub to create a central supplier quotation
  • Use central supplier quotation to create operational purchase orders or operational contracts in the respective connected backend ERP systems of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition Central hub

Business Benefits

  • Aggregate demand by pooling requisitions created in multiple connected backend systems into one central RFQ
  • Source the best supplier based on the aggregated demand, using the power of SAP Ariba Sourcing and Ariba Network
  • Seamless creation of purchase orders and contracts in the respective backend systems upon finalization of the Award process in SAP Ariba Sourcing
description_zh_html:
概览

SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition Hub 系统提供集中的 RFQ 流程，深度集成到客户的架构。它将 SAP Ariba Sourcing 连接到客户的 SAP ERP 或 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统（企业预置或云）。

使用 SAP S/4HANA Hub 系统，您可以池或汇总在多个连接的后端系统中创建的采购申请，以创建单个集中 RFQ，从而获得更好的规模定价支持。

SAP Ariba Sourcing 提供对直观 RFX 工具的访问（针对信息请求、建议请求和反向竞标），连接到超过 200 万家公司，快速轻松地发现供应商，自动化协商过程并可进行调整。

在 SAP Ariba Sourcing 中完成授标流程后，在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition Hub 系统中创建的供应商合同会在相应的已连接后端系统中生成采购订单或合同。

关键流程流

  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中心系统中为在连接的后端系统（集中采购员）中创建的采购申请创建集中 RFQ
  • 将集中 RFQ 发送到 SAP Ariba Sourcing 应用程序，这将触发 SAP Ariba 中的寻源请求
  • 访问您的工作清单并将寻源请求转换为寻源项目/事件（寻源经理）
  • 监控产生 RFI/RFP/竞标的寻源项目，通过 Ariba Network 发现供应商，并监控供应商的响应（寻源经理）
  • 在 SAP Ariba Sourcing 中授标一个或多个投标（寻源经理）
  • 将中标自动发送到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中央中心以创建集中供应商报价
  • 使用集中供应商报价在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中央中心的相应连接后端 ERP 系统中创建运营采购订单或运营合同

业务优势

  • 通过将在多个连接的后端系统中创建的申请集中到一个集中 RFQ 中来聚合需求
  • 利用 SAP Ariba Sourcing 和 Ariba Network 的强大功能，基于聚合需求寻找最佳供应商
  • 在 SAP Ariba Sourcing 中完成授标流程后，在相应后端系统中无缝创建采购订单和合同
